narr: Persistent moist monsoonal flow fueled thunderstorms over southeast California. Several storms produced flash flooding, and a few produced severe weather.
ev: Flooding blocked Highway 62 and Parker Dam Road, and there were rockslides along Parker Dam Road.
Highway 62 was flooded, and Lucerne Vista Ave was flooded between Yucca Trail and Pueblo Trail.
Highway 95 was flooded just south of the CA/NV state line.
Swiftly flowing water up to the windows of a car swept it off of Highway 95.
